note: Sample data for frontend development. Identifiers and life dates for Elgar and the Sea Pictures lyricists are drawn from real RISM person records established during the ETC/RISM data modelling work.

people.name: Edward Elgar
people.biography: English composer, best known for the Enigma Variations, the Pomp and Circumstance Marches, and the cello and violin concertos.

people.name: Alice Elgar
people.biography: Novelist and poet; wife of Edward Elgar from 1889. Wrote the text for 'In Haven', one of the Sea Pictures songs.

people.name: Roden Noel
people.biography: English poet whose verse provided the text for 'Sea Slumber Song', the opening song of Sea Pictures.

people.name: Richard Garnett
people.biography: Writer and Keeper of Printed Books at the British Museum; his poem 'Where Corals Lie' was set as the fourth song of Sea Pictures.

people.name: Adam Lindsay Gordon
people.biography: Australian poet; his verse provided the text for 'The Swimmer', the closing song of Sea Pictures.

people.name: Elizabeth Barrett Browning
people.biography: English poet whose verse was set as 'Sabbath Morning at Sea', the third song of Sea Pictures.
